messages:
maria.g: FYI a couple of customers reported SCIM failures after IdP session expiries. We see a provisioning loop with 401s and repeated re-attempts. Anyone seen this pattern?
jonathan.k: Can you paste the short excerpt from the gateway logs?
sec-bot: Alert: SCIM sync failure for acct `acme-corp` (error 401) at 2026-11-03T14:07:02Z
lee_ops: Logs look like the SCIM client is trying to reuse a stale SAML assertion / session cookie. IdP returns 401 -> SCIM client immediately retries with same token.
maria.g: excerpt:
```
2026-11-03T14:06:58Z WARN scim-client provision user jdoe status=401 reason="invalid_session"
2026-11-03T14:06:58Z INFO scim-client retry attempt=1
2026-11-03T14:07:02Z WARN scim-client provision user jdoe status=401 reason="invalid_session"
```
alexa_sre: Are these customers on our new SAML sessionShortTTL setting? We rolled a shorter default last week.
tara_pm: Yes, two of them opted into sessionShortTTL=5m for tighter security. Could be too aggressive combined with their IdP idle-timeouts.
jonathan.k: Two angles: 1) client should stop immediate retry on 401 and re-initiate auth flow. 2) server should log more specific SAML assertion errors (expired vs invalid).
maria.g: Agreed. Current SCIM client code treats 401 as transient and retries. I'll open a quick patch to back off and trigger auth refresh.
lee_ops: Also seeing `KMS access denied` in one trace right before the 401, maybe key rotation affected session cookie signing. Stack: scim -> session-svc -> crypto-kms.
jonathan.k: Can you attach the KMS error?
maria.g: snippet:
```
error: access denied
service=crypto-kms principal=service:session-svc action=encrypt key=projects/redwood/keys/session-signing
```
alexa_sre: If session-svc couldn't sign a new token, downstream SCIM calls would fail auth. That'd produce 401s and the retry loop.
tara_pm: Is this tied to last night's KMS rotation job? We had a scheduled key rollover at 02:00 UTC.
lee_ops: Yes rotation finished but one service's IAM binding didn't reapply correctly for `session-svc`. I can reapply the binding now.
jonathan.k: In the short term, we should: 1) pause SCIM syncs for affected customers (avoid noisy retries), 2) fix IAM binding, 3) push SCIM client backoff patch.
maria.g: I paused the sync queue for acme-corp and beta-inc.
sec-bot: Incident created: INC-20261103-78 - SCIM provisioning loop due to expired assertions and KMS IAM drift
alexa_sre: For audit logging, any gaps? We need a clear trail: which key version signed what. Might be missing if session-svc couldn't talk to KMS.
lee_ops: Our audit logs show KMS requests from the job runner but a 403 for session-svc. There's a gap between 02:00 and 02:12 where session tokens were failing.
tara_pm: Notify customers with a short status note. I'll draft now. @maria.g can you include suggested mitigation (re-sync once we confirm key bindings)?
maria.g: Drafted: "We've paused provisioning while we fix session key access; no user data is lost; re-sync will be run after validated key access"
jonathan.k: After IAM fix, we should rotate the intermediate key version to force all services to re-sign tokens gracefully and avoid long-lived stale assertions. Also add a 401->auth-refresh path in scim client.
lee_ops: IAM binding reapplied. Running a smoke test to sign a token as session-svc...
lee_ops: smoke result: sign OK, KMS responded 200, signed_token_v=3
alexa_sre: Great. Can we trigger a controlled re-sync for the paused customers and watch for regressions?
maria.g: Re-enabled queue for acme-corp and beta-inc at 14:22 UTC. Monitoring for errors.
sec-bot: Update: incident INC-20261103-78 severity downgraded to P2 after KMS fix at 14:22 UTC
jonathan.k: Follow-ups: - add guard in scim client to stop immediate retries on 401 and call auth refresh - improve session-svc logs to include key version and KMS request IDs - add test that simulates KMS 403 and ensures graceful failover - update runbook to include verifying IAM bindings after rotations
tara_pm: I'll add these to the roadmap and assign owners. Good catch everyone :thumbsup:
maria.g: I'll open the PR for the backoff in scim client now, link after created.
jonathan.k: Thanks, team. Let's also add an alert that spikes on repeated 401s per customer to catch this sooner.
